name: hover-card
useFor: Use to preview what a link points to without leaving the page (a merchant's status, an order's items). The trigger must still work as a link on its own; the card is for sighted pointer users only, so never put the only copy of anything in it.
constraints: Actions or forms inside the card (use a popover)
A hover card on a button
The only way to reach information
source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (.win) and popover.tsx
title: Hover Card
description: A preview of a merchant, an order or a person that opens beside a link under the pointer.
